heroMockup: An AI answer card (search box + streamed answer + numbered source chips) where a buyer's question is answered with other brands, then a question-by-question visibility tracker, a content pipeline (expert interview to approved pieces in the brand voice), a weekly ad-variant board and a personalized outbound draft waiting for approval. No other unit uses the AI answer + question tracker + content pipeline combination.
sourceOfClaims: src/i18n/units/growth.ts (hero, pains, offers, method, faq, cta), src/components/unit/visuals/copy.ts (growth: question, brand placeholder, source labels, 'Ad variant 14 testing', 'written for 1 person'), src/components/widgets/GeoAnswer/copy.ts (Brand A/B/C placeholders, levers) and the blog posts generative-engine-optimization-guide and ai-content-without-the-slop (entity consistency, third-party mentions, source library, voice and claims guide). Timelines used only as stated: Audit 1 week, Calibrate 1 week, Launch 2-3 weeks, Publish weekly / Monthly report, first outputs weeks 3-5. No results, percentages or growth figures are shown; mock UI numbers (variant 14, question 3 of the set) are illustrative UI states. The 'no one can guarantee citations' line comes straight from the FAQ.
